Overview

Newcastle is a city in New South Wales with a population of 498,565. NSW’s second city with a revitalized waterfront, surf beaches, and a thriving arts and food scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
